question: Should OpenClaw adopt local, container, reverse-proxy, and node-mode as the initial named hosting support catalog, conditional on acceptance of RFC 0018?
rationale: The patch is a coherent proposal, but choosing permanent supported deployment postures and their configuration contract is a product and compatibility decision that source review cannot settle.

options.title: Sequence after RFC 0018
options.body: Keep this RFC open and decide the profile catalog after the readiness contract and extension boundary have been accepted.

options.title: Accept the catalog now
options.body: Approve the four postures as the intended product contract and create a separately owned implementation tracker with explicit upgrade tests.

options.title: Defer named profiles
options.body: Retain readiness as the only current direction and revisit named support postures when operator demand and ownership are clearer.

recommendation.title: Sequence after RFC 0018
recommendation.body: Keep this RFC open and decide the profile catalog after the readiness contract and extension boundary have been accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal author has the clearest available RFC-history signal and can coordinate the requested decision with the appropriate product owners.
